title: Blessing of Light
dek: Three themes. Nine boons. Compare the effects and costs below.
sources: Fenumion 21–25 · Blessing of Light · A1:H60 · checked 17 October 2026 · https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Qk8H3SMq7-8_raesIkaPdNoq4XqgNsJpZRStwlg278o/edit#gid=1946222217
body:
← Browse all blessings

Read down each theme to compare its three tiers. Each boon shows its listed cost. Open “Full original wording” for the complete passage, including its descriptive text.

Tier 11cost
Tier 22cost
Tier 33cost
Theme 1

The Illuminated

Tier 1Cost 1

You see through all forms of magical darkness as if in dim light.

Full original wording

Where others see only shadow, your gaze pierces the void. Not even the deepest night nor the blackest magic can veil the truth from your eyes. You see through all forms of magical darkness as if in dim light.

Tier 2Cost 2

Enemies have disadvantage on saves against spells and abilites that deal radiant damage, and once per day, you may deal maximum radiant damage instead of rolling.

Full original wording

The light within you knows no restraint. When you call upon it, it answers not with a whisper, but with the roar of unfettered radiance. Enemies have disadvantage on saves against spells and abilites that deal radiant damage, and once per day, you may deal maximum radiant damage instead of rolling.

Tier 3Cost 3

You gain resistance to radiant damage, and once per short rest, you can use your reaction to become immune to that instance of damage.

Full original wording

The brilliance that sears others finds no purchase in your soul. You are of the light, and it shall never turn against you. You gain resistance to radiant damage, and once per short rest, you can use your reaction to become immune to that instance of damage.

Theme 2

The Flame

Tier 1Cost 1

On a critical attack roll, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of their next turn.

Full original wording

Light spills from your blade in blinding waves, an overwhelming radiance that punishes those foolish enough to face you directly. On a critical attack roll, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of their next turn.

Tier 2Cost 2

Once per action, you may deal additional radiant damage equal to your proficiency bonus.

Full original wording

Your weapon becomes a conduit of pure radiance, each strike unleashing a blinding force of divine energy that scorches flesh. Once per action, you may deal additional radiant damage equal to your proficiency bonus.

Tier 3Cost 3

A sacred light surrounds you, impossible for the dead to bear. Their hollow eyes flinch away, unable to meet your gaze or endure your presence. Undead attacks have disadvantage against you.

Full original wording

A sacred light surrounds you, impossible for the dead to bear. Their hollow eyes flinch away, unable to meet your gaze or endure your presence. Undead attacks have disadvantage against you.

Theme 3

The Juggernaut

Tier 1Cost 1

You are immune to the frightened condition while in bright light. When an enemy attempts to frighten you, they must also make the saving throw or experience the effects of the spell or ability they attempted to target you with.

Full original wording

Radiance fills your heart like a rising dawn. With it comes clarity, purpose, and a courage that no shadow can smother. You are immune to the frightened condition while in bright light. When an enemy attempts to frighten you, they must also make the saving throw or experience the effects of the spell or ability they attempted to target you with.

Tier 2Cost 2

You are immune to the blinded condition

Full original wording

You see as the stars see—steady, eternal, and immune to the flickers of blindness that plague lesser beings. You are immune to the blinded condition

Tier 3Cost 3

Your attack rolls that deal radiant damage cannot be resisted. This only applies to the radiant damage done, as well as divine smite, should you chose to use it

Full original wording

Your light does not ask permission—it pierces all things, burning through shadow, armor, and soul with divine inevitability. Your attack rolls that deal radiant damage cannot be resisted. This only applies to the radiant damage done, as well as divine smite, should you chose to use it
